parrafo_1.es: The Lawn Butcher es el negocio de paisajismo de Kyle en Lakeland. Diseña y transforma patios traseros, instala césped, coloca mulch y bordes de aluminio, y resuelve la remoción de vegetación vieja antes de empezar de cero.
parrafo_1.en: The Lawn Butcher is Kyle's landscaping business in Lakeland. He designs and transforms backyards, installs sod, lays mulch and aluminum borders, and handles ripping out old vegetation before starting fresh.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes repiten lo mismo: comunicación excelente, cumple los plazos y el resultado se mantiene. Jessica instaló St. Augustine Seville en un patio húmedo y sombreado en octubre de 2022 y seguía floreciendo un año después.
parrafo_2.en: His clients keep saying the same thing: great communication, he hits the timeline, and the result holds up. Jessica had St. Augustine Seville installed in a wet, shaded backyard in October 2022, and it was still flourishing a year later.

items.quote: Kyle and his crew did an amazing job upgrading our landscaping. I gave him my vision for the backyard and he delivered 1000% and delivered on my unrealistic timeline for an outdoor party we were having to boot! Everyone loved the work they did! Great communication and even better work ethic. If you need to upgrade your yard or landscaping, give him a call. Update: the guys came back to do mulch, sod, and aluminum landscape border. They did a jam up job and made the front yard pop.

The Lawn Butcher is the real deal for all your landscaping needs! Kyle just got done completely transforming our backyard. He tore out all the vegetation, put in new mulch, and laid Provista sod. We could not be more happy with how it turned out. Kyle provided excellent customer service from start to finish always showing up on time and working with us to give us exactly what we wanted. Giving him a 5 star review was a no brainer. Stop looking and hire him now!

Our backyard is very shaded and very wet during the rainy season. The sod we installed when we built the house didn't last 1 year. We consulted with Kyle about the type of sod to install that would last. We went with his recommendation of St Augustine Seville and he installed it last October 2022. It is still flourishing and looks as perfect as the day it was installed in July of 2023! Would recommend The Lawn Butcher to anyone looking for new sod. You're in great hands with Kyle!
